summary: Learn to negotiate AI and data contracts covering liability, IP, GDPR, governance, and SLAs. Build practical drafting skills with TrainingCred.
lede: AI and data services contract risk management helps legal, procurement, and governance teams address supplier and data-related exposure. The course covers verifying data rights, assessing suppliers, drafting clauses on model changes and output ownership, and allocating liability and incident duties. Participants practise contract reviews, risk allocation, negotiation, and monitoring controls to clarify obligations and track supplier performance.
audienceIntro: AI legal risk management training is designed for professionals who translate technology, data, procurement, and governance requirements into workable contractual controls.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of commercial contracts, procurement, privacy, information security, or AI governance is expected. No programming is required. You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based risk scoring and digital contract mapping exercises. Participants do not need legal qualification, but should be able to read standard service agreement provisions. Advanced AI topics are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering level.
